description: Negative vector for the ping strict-allowlist PII boundary: SPEC.md §4 defines the ping schema as an allowlist (additionalProperties: false), not a blocklist — any field outside it (raw PII especially) is a validation error LCP-008 PII_IN_PING. The non-ping_safe *declared* vertical-attribute path (loan_amount_cents on a mortgage ping) is already locked by the shared corpus fixture sdk-012 and test-vectors/conformance.py check_ping_safe and is deliberately NOT duplicated here; this vector covers the undeclared/PII field path with its error code.

vectors.spec_ref: SPEC.md §4 ping (strict allowlist; any other field -> LCP-008); SPEC.md §5; SPEC.md §9 PII
vectors.description: Valid ping envelope (corpus fixture sdk-002) with a raw 'phone' field added to the payload. The ping schema carries phone_hash only; raw phone numbers MUST NOT cross the ping boundary and must be rejected as LCP-008.
